verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents a first-party SSO plugin supporting OIDC, OAuth2 and SAML 2.0, alongside an organization plugin for multi-tenancy, and the homepage markets SSO, SAML, SCIM and directory sync as enterprise features. However, the evidence never shows SSO connections scoped to individual organizations, domain verification, or just-in-time user provisioning, and a community member notes some of these features are enterprise-only. Missing for 10: documented per-organization SSO connection binding, verified-domain ownership checks, JIT provisioning on first SSO login, independent hands-on corroboration.
